summary: Allendale County, SC steel tower built around 1933 by the CCC as the Edisto Tower; sold and moved to private Butterfield Plantation in 2005; NHLR-registered 2012.

facts.design: 110-foot Bethlehem Steel tower with a 7x7 foot steel cab and pivot-out windows
facts.agency: South Carolina Forestry Commission (original owner, until the 2005 sale)

access.note: Register says the tower was moved to private property and it stands at Butterfield Plantation; no public access described in the sources read

events.note: Constructed circa 1933 by the CCC per the register; the Butterfield Plantation post says it was built as the Edisto Tower in 1933
Purchased from the Forestry Commission and moved to private property in October 2005; the Facebook post says it was decommissioned, moved and erected at Butterfield that year
Registered April 19, 2012 as US 941, SC 10; nominated by Michael T. Finch Jr., MD

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register spells the original town 'Bamburg', most likely a typo for Bamberg; Forest Lookouts places the original tower in Bamberg County. The story quotes the register's spelling and reads it as Bamberg.

sources.title: The Butterfield Fire Tower, built as the Edisto Tower in 1933 (video post)

notes_for_editor: Build date is circa 1933 per the register and 1933 per the Facebook post, so it is treated as solid. Staffing, notable fires and any recent condition report were not found; the Forest Lookouts page has only the 2005 sale. The register's 'Bamburg' is read as a typo for Bamberg. The Facebook post comes from the Butterfield Plantation page, so its statements are the owner's account. The status 'standing' in the record is consistent with the post's account of the tower being erected at Butterfield, so it is not changed. Used 1 WebSearch and about 5 page reads.
